content:
STAGE: ranking of TOLLCAP-SID / HCAUDIT-SID / SHELL-CURV-RQ / BEHTIE-SNAP under rank-2026-10-v1.
READ: bundles 161fcdb9b7feae10, 74c5b8ade98d61c0, c874d36a065c5ff6, 01b6cc76bd242e2a plus scope contract and one-run/no-ablation policy.
OBSERVED: shared e6/e7/e8/e11 (l1_br 0.04671 with perfect depth-1 survival vs resample 0.06363 with 0.497; K=256 co-clustering 0.0822; same-prefix 0.0907 vs null 0.067) and the record that curved residual 0.05439, global geodesic pull 0.05165, PPMI fourth level 0.04823 all lost recall, tracking distance from text geometry rather than prefix count; behaviour contrast is the positive predictor (+0.7104).
REASONING: cell membership of a bounded noise-floor tail is the untested degree of freedom. TOLLCAP is first: capacity-frozen transport keeps codebooks, vocabulary and all cell sizes identical, each relabel bounded by eps_rec, lambda=eps_rec/sigma_A derived, Poincare radius factor makes curvature load-bearing; main risk empty shell. HCAUDIT second: statistically calibrated null, emergent budget and measured prefix guard, but it changes occupancies/prefix counts and its 20-permutation 99.5th-percentile rule may reject nearly all items. BEHTIE third: honest data-derived curvature and impurity-based level choice, but a median-error band is a half-population band not a tie shell, deeper codes stay stale, 0.5/0.5 weights not derived. SHELL fourth: geometry acts only on PPMI points while shell and candidates are Euclidean, so geometry-off likely reproduces the ranking; per-epoch training intervention and c=1 gauge carry no measured radius effect.
OPEN: none; verdict recorded.
ANSWER:
RANK: TOLLCAP-SID | position=1 | reason=the only arm whose capacity-frozen transport keeps codebooks, vocabulary and every cell size equal to baseline while the Poincare chord factor 1/(1-||m_s||^2) prices each relabel against derived lambda=eps_rec/sigma_A, so both terms are load-bearing and the eps_rec-bounded shell avoids the distance-from-text-geometry loss seen at 0.05439/0.05165/0.04823.
RANK: HCAUDIT-SID | position=2 | reason=the degree-stratified permutation null (grounded in 0.0907 same-prefix vs 0.067 permuted null), emergent 5% budget, Lorentzian score and measured +/-5% guard keep a contrast-driven repair inside the measured geometry, but it changes the cell occupancy and prefix counts e6/e8 show are not the lever and its 20-permutation 99.5th-percentile rule may reject almost every item.
RANK: BEHTIE-SNAP | position=3 | reason=curvature c=(artanh(0.9)/q95||b||)^2 and impurity-based level choice are data-derived, but rho_l = median squared error is roughly a half-population band not a tie shell, so it can replay the whole-partition displacement that lost recall (0.048-0.054), leaves deeper codes stale, and its 0.5/0.5 weights are asserted not derived.
RANK: SHELL-CURV-RQ | position=4 | reason=the 5% margin budget is a hard derived bound, but the curved distance acts only on PPMI behaviour points while shell membership and candidates are Euclidean, so its geometry-off control would likely return the same ranking (its own risk), it perturbs the training assignment every epoch rather than a frozen post-hoc pass, and c=1 is a bare gauge carrying none of the measured radius effect.
